description: A modern pendant light fixture featuring three heart-shaped frames suspended from a circular white ceiling plate. Each heart encloses a light bulb with a colored accent at the top. The frames have a metallic finish, with colors ranging from a deep purple to a vibrant pink and a subtle bronze. The bulbs themselves are clear, suggesting an Edison-style bulb, and cast a soft glow. The design is elegant and whimsical, suitable for adding a touch of romance or playful charm to a room. The overall aesthetic is contemporary with a playful nod to love themes.
